command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP: install aide =="
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
sudo -n apt-get update -qq
sudo -n apt-get install -y -qq aide aide-common >/tmp/aide-install.log 2>&1
dpkg -l | grep -i aide

echo "== STEP: configure aide.conf for /etc baseline =="
sudo -n cp /etc/aide/aide.conf /etc/aide/aide.conf.orig

# Build a minimal, focused config: strong ruleset + /etc recursively, database stored outside /etc
sudo -n tee /etc/aide/aide.conf >/dev/null <<'AIDE_EOF'
# Integrity baseline configuration - scoped to /etc
database=file:/var/lib/aide/aide.db
database_out=file:/var/lib/aide/aide.db.new
database_new=file:/var/lib/aide/aide.db.new
gzip_dbout=no

# Rule: full metadata + content hash
FullRule = p+i+n+u+g+s+m+c+md5+sha256+acl+xattrs

/etc FullRule
AIDE_EOF

sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/aide

echo "== STEP: initialize baseline database =="
sudo -n aide --config=/etc/aide/aide.conf --init

echo "== STEP: install baseline db as the active db =="
sudo -n cp /var/lib/aide/aide.db.new /var/lib/aide/aide.db
sudo -n chmod 600 /var/lib/aide/aide.db /var/lib/aide/aide.db.new

echo "== STEP: record baseline metadata =="
date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ" | sudo -n tee /var/lib/aide/baseline-created-at.txt >/dev/null
sha256sum /var/lib/aide/aide.db | sudo -n tee /var/lib/aide/aide.db.sha256 >/dev/null

echo "== VERIFY: db exists =="
ls -la /var/lib/aide/

echo "== VERIFY: run a check against the just-created baseline (expect clean) =="
sudo -n aide --config=/etc/aide/aide.conf --check | tail -40 || true

echo "== DONE =="
